text.tspan: - Migration/markdown tables use display:block; overflow:auto — they scroll on mobile (not broken), but a multi-column matrix is
genuinely cramped at 390px with no scroll hint. Valid but mild.
- The "code is truncated/broken" claim is disconfirmed — Expressive Code blocks scroll and have a copy button. I'm downgrading it
to an optional soft-wrap nicety, not filing it as a bug.
I have a fully reconciled picture. Let me file the tickets. Loading the create tool:
Reconciliation complete. Filing per-issue tickets (grouping tightly-related fixes, keeping separable ones apart). Creating them
All eight tickets filed (KF-543–KF-550). Now let me complete KF-542 with the synthesis note.
KF-542 is completed and the claim released. No code changed (review-only, per the skill), so nothing to commit or integrate. The
worklist's single Up Next item is done, with 8 follow-up tickets filed. Signaling completion.
Done. Processed the worklist's one Up Next item, KF-542 (website UI/UX review), end to end.
- The Chrome extension was declined, so I rendered real pixels with Playwright instead — built site/ locally, served dist/
under /kerf, and captured desktop (1280px) + mobile (390px) screenshots of representative pages across all five surfaces
(homepage, docs, complete-apps index + pages, migration guides, demo SVGs).
- Ran my own ruthless-designer review, then got an independent second opinion from a fresh subagent on the same screenshots, and
reconciled — verifying the one real disagreement against the built CSS rather than averaging.
Key reconciliation call: the second reviewer claimed code blocks were "truncated — a correctness bug." I checked the built CSS
(.expressive-code pre { overflow-x:auto } + a copy button) and disconfirmed it — the blocks scroll and copy fine; the screenshot
just showed scroll-0. So I did not file it as a bug.
- High: hero hierarchy / single primary CTA (KF-543), promote "Run live" to a button on app pages (KF-544), redesign the double-
listing complete-apps index as a card grid (KF-545).
- Default: "Side-by-side code" is actually stacked (KF-546), weak demo first-frames (KF-547, overlaps KF-538), mobile table
- Low: long-docs TOC depth (KF-549), minor polish (KF-550).
KF-543 and KF-546 carry FEEDBACK-NEEDED taste questions (value-first headline; 2-col-vs-rename) recorded in-ticket for when
they're picked up. No code changed — the skill produces the review + tickets, not edits. Nothing to commit. Signaled done.
